methods.name: C12 quarter-turn torsor and tetrahedral face-flatness calculus
capabilities: exact CRT decompositions C6=C3xC2 and C12=C3xC4
quarter-turn root torsor and inversion action
tetrahedral edge coboundary and face holonomy
global-root reconstruction unique up to overall reversal
face transport on the local root torsor
methods.exactness: finite integer/bit enumeration only; no floating point, angle, trigonometry, or numerical pi
boundaries: overlap signs are inputs rather than derived native transport
face flatness is characterized but not forced by P000
the overall chirality remains a C2 torsor
J is a derived rotation character rather than a primitive spatial axis
